arguments.reason: Discrepancy between declared packed SKU and warehouse seal scan record: artifact.packed_sku declares BATT-B, but authority_records.packing_records[SHIP-6202] shows actual packed SKU is BATT-A. While manifest SKU (BATT-A) matches the warehouse record and SDS-A independently applies to BATT-A with compliant carrier/packaging, the packed_sku declaration mismatch requires verification that the correct product was actually packed before release.
